answer: Like mineral crystallization, agents solidify trust from liquid chaos, each transaction an iridescent opal facet binding mutual stake. In our Proof of Agent network, every consensus vote acts as an immutable quill etching bonded reputation into the ledger. When a coordinated Sybil assault plunges genuine stake toward its nadir, quadratic slashing activates: minting clone identities incurs superlinear attacker cost that burns capital exponentially faster than any consensus power gained.
